quotes.author: Duane Degroot
quotes.text: Had a outstanding experience abroad the Firefly. Chartered the Firefly for a private family event with my wife, brother, sister and niece when my brother was visiting from Germany in April. First time my brother, sister and I had been together since 1992 before my brother went to Germany. Capt Bobby and Jenny were the perfect hosts and accommodated all of our needs. The Firefly is beautiful and very comfortable. The weather was not perfect but the ride, accommodations and sunset were. Definitely an experience that we all greatly enjoyed and will always cherish.

quotes.author: Evelyn Kikta
quotes.text: Amazing!!! We have been several times because once is not nearly enough. ❤️. It’s an escape from reality and a sense of peace and happiness as soon as you set foot on the gorgeous vessel. Captain Bobby and first mate Jeanny make sure that your time on board exceeds your expectations. Seeing the sun setting while cruising in the Anclote River is breathtaking. They are a wealth of knowledge on local history because of their long time roots in Tarpon Springs. Unforgettable!!!!

quotes.author: Garrett Gause
quotes.text: What an incredible experience to cruise the river, have dinner (delicious!) and watch the sunset on such a beautiful and nostalgic yacht! Especially with Captain Bobby and First mate Jeannie as your hosts and guides. They are a wonderful couple and we had an absolutely amazing and enjoyable time celebrating our granddaughter’s birthday and graduation. This is First Rate so don’t miss this adventure! The dolphins and manatee sightings were a great bonus!

quotes.author: Scott Tucker
quotes.text: What a great experience. Getting up on the top deck was so relaxing. I can't say enough about the captain and crew, they're perfect. Unfortunately it was overcast and we didn't see the sunset. But that was OK. We got to see beautiful birds, dolphin and the Anclote Key Lighthouse. Truly a great evening on the water.

quotes.author: Melissa Hill
quotes.text: The Firefly was such an incredible experience. From the moment you step on the boat with all of its nautical charm… The delicious food… the beautiful views…the wonderful Captain and the wonderful first mate…the talented chef… I could go on and on… It was such a special experience! I can’t wait to go back!! ❤️

quotes.author: Sarah Zambrotto
quotes.text: What a beautiful day onboard the Firefly! I seriously love this boat… it’s charming, has character, style - plus an award winning chef?!? What more could you ask for! Captain Bobby and First Mate Jeanny are a wealth of knowledge and such gracious host. I can’t wait to go again for a sunset cruise next time.
